article.title: Strategus擴大PubMatic體育CTV合作，地域定向仍受庫存限制
article.title_en: Strategus expands PubMatic sports CTV partnership with inventory limits
article.summary: 11月5日公布把即時體育庫存與代管投放結合，支援按賽事及市場規劃。
article.summary_en: The November 5 announcement combines live-sports inventory with managed execution by event and market.
highlights: 規劃維度包括聯盟、隊伍及比賽時段。
DMA與ZIP定向須視庫存是否容許。
highlights_en: Planning dimensions include leagues, teams and game windows.
DMA and ZIP targeting depend on available inventory.
article.why: 本地服務品牌可把賽事熱度與服務範圍一併考慮，減少只按全國曝光量買入的盲點。
article.why_en: Local-service brands can assess sports attention alongside their service footprint.
article.next_step: 要求媒體夥伴列明目標市場的可買賽事、最低投放量及版位層級報告。
article.next_step_en: Ask partners for purchasable events, minimum spend and placement-level reports in the target market.
article.detail: 公告以美國賓夕法尼亞州Citadel Credit Union的2026世界盃投放作合作例子，沒有提供可獨立核對的銷售或回報數字。平台列出的能力包括賽程資料及節目、版位層級報告；實際可買到的地域粒度仍取決於庫存。香港品牌若考慮海外賽事投放，應先把服務市場、可買權利及量度方式逐項確認，不能假設所有賽事均有相同覆蓋。
article.detail_en: The release names a Pennsylvania credit-union World Cup campaign without reporting verified sales lift. Schedule data and granular reporting are described capabilities. Available geography still depends on inventory, so overseas buyers should check rights, markets and measurement.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
